crossRefs.note: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son…
Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

people.name: Er
people.line: Judah's firstborn son, killed by God for his wickedness.

people.name: Tamar
people.line: Judah's daughter-in-law who bore Perez and Zerah

translations.web: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
translations.bsb: Now Judah acquired a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
translations.kjv: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
translations.asv: And Judah took a wife for Er his first-born, and her name was Tamar.
